notes: go test ./internal/server/ ok (15.6s) and go vet ./internal/server/ clean at the pinned head. Many server test gaps are already carried by the known ledger (routineSession, run history, bootstrap status, profile test, audience-change sync, i18n catalog completeness, legacy non-developer, git-dir-untouched add, cross-instance delete, LoadFragment marker sites, request-time reload, fingerprintErr term, permissions default dimension) and are not re-reported.

findings.fix: Add a TestPresentationStore_SaveProfileSelection case that t.Chdir()s into a temp dir holding settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md (frontmatter + body) and asserts the saved file is the new frontmatter followed by the template body with its own frontmatter stripped; add a direct stripFrontMatter table (no frontmatter, unterminated, normal).
findings.claim: The casual+German template seeding branch of saveProfileSelection (presentation.go:97-103) and stripFrontMatter (184-195) have no test: the only casual+de case (de-casual-creates) runs with the test cwd internal/server where settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md does not exist, so it asserts the frontmatter-only fallback. Spec-12 Tests names the case 'de+non-developer seeds the template body'. Deleting the seeding block, breaking the cwd-relative template path, or making stripFrontMatter return the input unchanged keeps go test ./internal/server/ green, while a first casual-German save on a real install then writes a body-less profile (or a doubled frontmatter block).
findings.evidence:
Re-read presentation.go:88-112 and 174-195 at 1f725ce: seeding only runs when body=="" && audience==casual && language==de, reading filepath.Join("settings","claude_code","presentation-profile.de.md") relative to cwd. git ls-files confirms the template exists only at repo-root settings/claude_code/. presentation_test.go:318-331 comment states 'The repo template is not readable from the test cwd, so the body falls back to empty — the seeding path is frontmatter-only here' and expects '---
language: de
audience: casual
dev-mode: false
---
'. grep over internal/ and cmd/ finds no other caller or test of stripFrontMatter or the template path. config_sync_test.go:123 already uses t.Chdir, so the fix is on-pattern. Not in the known ledger (tests-MIN-18-r1 is the legacy non-developer value, a different branch).

findings.fix: Extend TestBatchBands with a languageGerman case asserting the label "Auswertung 1–10", and assert the German scope/batch titles ("Sitzungen — personal", "personal · Auswertung 1") in a de-profile TestSessionsPages variant.
findings.claim: The new Go-side translations in sessions.go — batchBands' format key "Batch %d-%d" (219), the batch page title key "Batch" (115) and the scope title key "Sessions" (172) — are only ever exercised with languageEnglish (TestBatchBands passes languageEnglish; no sessions test uses a de profile). A drift between the Go literal and the germanCatalog key (e.g. the key edited to an en dash) silently renders English on a casual German install with every test green.
findings.evidence: Re-read sessions.go:103-116, 154-175, 213-230 and i18n.go:93-95 at 1f725ce: translate is called with s.presentation.language() / the language param; the catalog keys are byte-exact lookups that fall back to identity. sessions_test.go:480-506 calls batchBands(..., languageEnglish) only; grep for "Auswertung" over sessions_test.go, overview_test.go, repos_test.go, presentation_test.go and server_test.go returns no match. Known ledger tests-NIT-9-r1 covers overview.go tile details and tests-MIN-7-r1 covers template {{t}} keys — neither covers these sessions.go Go-side keys.

findings.fix: Add a TestWorktreeStatusFragmentServesCache step (or sibling test) whose status stub exits 1 on the first call: assert StatusErr renders, statusCache.Get("demo") stays absent, and the next plain load re-runs the script.
findings.claim: No test covers the status-cache write guard 'if err == nil' in handleRepoWorktreeStatus (repos.go:361-364): every worktree-status test uses a status stub that exits 0. If the guard is dropped, a transient print_agent_worktrees_status.sh failure caches nil statuses under the current fingerprint and every later plain load serves 'No agent branches' without re-scanning until refs change — and the suite stays green.
findings.evidence: Re-read repos.go:352-368 at 1f725ce: Store is reached only on err == nil; data.Cached requires a matching fingerprint, so a stored nil entry would be served by every plain load. repos_test.go status stubs (lines 46, 135-139, 318-322, 359-363, 380-385, 413-416) all exit 0; the only 'exit 1' stubs (494, 741) target remove_agent_worktrees.sh and osascript. Known tests-NIT-52-r1 covers only the fingerprintErr == nil term, not this guard.
